responsibility: Handles registration of new shipments with origin, destination, and mandatory delivery deadline; assigns unique tracking identifiers; validates that origin and destination differ and are selected from registered logistics locations; supports registration before a route is defined.

Provides consolidated administrative views of shipments grouped by business status (unrouted, routed and in transit, collected by recipient); allows opening shipment details; tracks routed but uncollected shipments as in transit.

Manages route planning, candidate route retrieval, route validation against origin/destination/deadline, route association with shipments, identification of unrouted shipments, and trip replanning including destination changes and reassessment of routes for deviated shipments.
Provides route computation and candidate route retrieval via a pathfinder API, returning feasible routes based on origin, destination, and constraints.

Records and validates logistics events (receipt, loading, unloading, customs clearance, pickup); enforces event association with existing shipment, location, and trip where required; rejects invalid events; updates shipment operational status and recalculates transport status, known location, expected next step, and plan adherence; marks off-route, arrival, and completion states.
communicates_with: Shipment Registration;Routing and Planning;Monitoring and Tracking;Business Integrity and Audit

responsibility: Handles channel-specific intake of logistics events from operational interface, integration service, and input-file processing; performs format validation and forwards valid events to Logistics Event Processing; ensures uniform application of business rules across channels.

Provides read-only shipment lookup by tracking identifier, current status, last known location, estimated arrival time, event history, and geographic view; consumes authoritative status and location state from Logistics Event Processing without independently recalculating status.

Enforces uniform application of origin, destination, deadline, and route compatibility rules across all operational channels; preserves consistency among shipment registration, planned route, and completed events; ensures no invalid event alters shipment state; maintains sufficient history to reconstruct the logistics lifecycle; retains event occurrence and recording times; identifies rejected recording attempts for operational analysis; distinguishes correctly delivered, in-transit, and deviated shipments.
communicates_with: Shipment Registration;Routing and Planning;Logistics Event Processing;Channel Integration
